name: Vox Explainer
description: Documentary editorial style with 12fps stuttered graphics, yellow highlighter accents, rough-edged collage aesthetic, and film grain texture — inspired by Vox Media's explainer video format
styleGuidance: Vox documentary — deliberate imperfection over polish. Graphics stutter at 12fps within 30fps timelines. Yellow highlighter (#FFEB00) is the signature accent — sweep it across key text. Film grain on everything (25-35% opacity). Rough edges via feTurbulence displacement on shapes. No drop shadows, no gradients on text, no glossy surfaces. Evidence-first storytelling: every visual serves the argument. Progressive information disclosure — nothing appears all at once. Collage-style cutouts with intentionally imperfect edges. Flat 2D design, never 3D. Jump cuts preferred over transitions.
